entities.summary: Mario Zenari is an Italian prelate of the Catholic Church who has been a cardinal since 2016. He has served his entire ecclesiastical career in the diplomatic service of the Holy See, holding senior positions beginning in 1999. He was nuncio to Sri Lanka from 2004 to 2008 and to Syria from 2008 to 2026.
